name: Optimize NVIDIA Direct Flip & VRR
description: Minimizes timing margins for Direct Flip and VRR (G-SYNC/FreeSync), reducing display latency and improving frame pacing.
commands: $gpus=Get-CimInstance Win32_VideoController|Where-Object{$_.PNPDeviceID -like 'PCI\VEN_10DE*'}; foreach($g in $gpus){ $enum="HKLM:\SYSTEM\ControlSet001\Enum\$($g.PNPDeviceID)"; $drv=(Get-ItemProperty -Path $enum -Name Driver).Driver; $cls="HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Class\$drv"; New-ItemProperty -Path $cls -Name 'VRDirectFlipDPCDelayUs' -PropertyType DWord -Value 1 -Force; New-ItemProperty -Path $cls -Name 'VRDirectFlipTimingMarginUs' -PropertyType DWord -Value 1 -Force; New-ItemProperty -Path $cls -Name 'VRDirectJITFlipMsHybridFlipDelayUs' -PropertyType DWord -Value 1 -Force; New-ItemProperty -Path $cls -Name 'vrrCursorMarginUs' -PropertyType DWord -Value 1 -Force; New-ItemProperty -Path $cls -Name 'vrrDeflickerMarginUs' -PropertyType DWord -Value 1 -Force; New-ItemProperty -Path $cls -Name 'vrrDeflickerMaxUs' -PropertyType DWord -Value 1 -Force; }
revert22H2: $gpus=Get-CimInstance Win32_VideoController|Where-Object{$_.PNPDeviceID -like 'PCI\VEN_10DE*'}; foreach($g in $gpus){ $enum="HKLM:\SYSTEM\ControlSet001\Enum\$($g.PNPDeviceID)"; $drv=(Get-ItemProperty -Path $enum -Name Driver).Driver; $cls="HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Class\$drv"; Remove-ItemProperty -Path $cls -Name 'VRDirectFlipDPCDelayUs' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-ItemProperty -Path $cls -Name 'VRDirectFlipTimingMarginUs' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-ItemProperty -Path $cls -Name 'VRDirectJITFlipMsHybridFlipDelayUs' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-ItemProperty -Path $cls -Name 'vrrCursorMarginUs' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-ItemProperty -Path $cls -Name 'vrrDeflickerMarginUs' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-ItemProperty -Path $cls -Name 'vrrDeflickerMaxUs' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; }
